business_scope.primary_industry_name: Accounts Receivable Factoring and Cross-Border Reverse Factoring

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (English-based) with statutory civil registration and administrative law overlay
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No comprehensive bilateral investment treaty between Belize and major OECD counterparties is in force as of 2025; investment protection is derived from CARICOM instruments, domestic IBC law, and general common-law contract principles.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Business Companies Act, Chapter 270, Revised Edition 2020, as amended (the 'IBC Act'); Companies (Amendment) Act 2019 and International Business Companies (Amendment) Regulations 2018 (mandatory UBO register); Anti-Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing Act, Chapter 104, Revised Edition 2020, as amended (the 'AML/CFT Act'); Central Bank of Belize AML/CFT (Risk-Based Approach) Guidelines 2022; Financial Services Commission Act, Chapter 272, Revised Edition 2020; Economic Substance Act 2019 (Financing and Leasing relevant activity).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certified copy of each shareholder's and beneficial owner's valid passport
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority in the owner's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if issuer is a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention); otherwise Consular Legalization at the Belize Embassy or Consulate with jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement, not older than 90 days)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or regulated financial institution in the resident country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization; alternatively notarized attestation by a government-recognized notary without apostille where the registered agent's CDD manual permits

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional or bank reference letter (original on corporate letterhead)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed bank or licensed professional services firm that has conducted its own customer due diligence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille; for non-Hague states, Belize consular authentication

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Source of wealth and source of funds statement (AML/CFT mandatory for factoring IBC)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Applicant, law firm, or notary witnessing the declaration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized declaration with apostille or consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or equivalent for corporate shareholders
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of all UBOs, directors, officers, and counterparties against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, the UK Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation List, Belize's domestic sanctions list, and international criminal/ENP databases. PEPs and family members/close associates trigger enhanced due diligence (EDD), independent source-of-funds verification, and senior-management approval under Section 61 of the AML/CFT Act. Matches require immediate filing of a Suspicious Activity Report with the Belize Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) within 48 hours.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Belize Companies Registry – Online Name Search and Incorporation Portal (https://www.registry.gov.bz)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Official records require an English legal name in Latin script only; no non-English script, accents, punctuation, or special characters except standard corporate tokens. A transliteration or alternative script name may appear on ancillary documents, but the statutory register must contain a single English legal name. The name must not mislead as to the entity's commercial purpose and must comply with Belize's financial services nomenclature restrictions.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name rejection may be appealed by the applicant or registered agent within 14 business days of the Registrar's refusal by filing a written Notice of Administrative Appeal with the Belize Companies Registry, accompanied by the original rejection notification and a legal argument under Section 112 of the IBC Act. The Registrar must issue a written determination within 21 business days. If the administrative appeal fails, the applicant may, within 30 calendar days from the denial, file an originating motion before the Belize Supreme Court under the Civil Procedure Rules for judicial review. During appeal, a revised name application may be concurrently filed; any reservations expire automatically after 30 days unless extended by an additional reservation fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office may be used strictly as a correspondence and registered-address service, but every IBC must maintain a permanent registered office in Belize staffed by a licensed registered agent. For a factoring client engaged in trade-finance activities, the Economic Substance Act 2019 requires real and substantive management in respect of the 'Financing and Leasing' relevant activity; therefore, the registered office cannot be a mere virtual address. A physical local office for board meetings, record stewardship, and AML/CFT compliance must be arranged with the registered agent.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Risk quantified at 45% annual baseline for a licensed medium-risk trade-finance IBC, escalating to 60% within year one if an active factoring license is issued by the Belize Financial Services Commission. Unlicensed IBCs that maintain no economic substance in Belize fall into a 15%–25% inspection bracket.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company name search through Belize Companies Registry online portal
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee schedule, Belize Companies (Fees) Regulations 2018
Statutory fee schedule under the IBC Act

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: IBC certificate of incorporation government fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: IBC Act, First Schedule government tariff; does not include expedited-processing premium
Market benchmark; registered agent's fee circular 2025

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the Companies (Amendment) Act 2019

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT due diligence and KYC vetting for all UBOs (including PEP and sanctions screening)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Lead legal counsel / outsourced compliance provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing professional fee schedule for enhanced due diligence packages

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Source-of-wealth verification and notarized declaration preparation
Notarization, apostille, and consular legalization bundle (5 documents)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory consular authentication fee schedule plus notary public tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Regulatory legal opinion on factoring IBC activities and licensing under the Belize Financial Services Commission
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate for regulated IBC legal opinions

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Economic substance and trade-finance compliance advisory (Financing and Leasing relevant activity)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per scope of supply-chain factoring program

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate bank account / escrow account coordination fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Corporate services provider and receiving bank
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark; bank charging arrangements separate

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Business Companies Act (Cap. 270), Laws of Belize, Revised Edition 2011, ss. 16, 19 and 22; Income and Business Tax Act exemptions applied to IBCs
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry, Ministry of Finance, Belize City, Belize
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation pursuant to IBC Act Form 1, together with executed Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for a Belize IBC; authorized capital is set in the Memorandum at subscriber discretion, and no escrow account or mandatory capital deposit is required before incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION: (1) The execution of this written resolution dispenses with notice under s.70 of the IBC Act. (2) The proposed subscribers' allotment of ordinary par-value shares be ratified and issued. (3) The registered office of the Company at the address maintained by the licensed registered agent be adopted. (4) The directors named in the Articles, together with the Company Secretary, be appointed and confirmed. (5) Each director is authorized to open banking accounts, sign corporate contracts, engage counsel, and make all filings required under the International Business Companies Act and for licensing. This resolution takes effect immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name clearance and corporate due diligence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry through a licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a proposed corporate name and three alternates to the licensed agent for availability search; verify no conflict with existing Belize entities and no restricted words such as 'bank', 'trust', 'insurance' or 'reinsurance' unless separately licensed.
required_dossiers: Copy of government-issued identification of proposed subscriber
Brief description of proposed business activities
Power of attorney in favor of the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is reserved by an existing entity or found objectionable, file an alternate proposed name immediately; no further fee applies for a replacement name within the same application file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and filing of incorporation documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry, Belize City
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the Memorandum and Articles of Association before a notary public, then deliver the signed deed and Form 1 to the Registry through the licensed registered agent for issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: Consent and undertaking of registered agent
Certificate of good conduct or proof of identity for directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a query or deficiency letter, correct the Articles or consent documents through the agent and resubmit; minor defects are cured by filing an amendment or correction without prejudicing the intended incorporation date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: First board of directors of the Belize IBC
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting or adopt a written resolution to ratify share allotment, appoint officers, adopt the registered office, authorize banking signatories and issue share certificates.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any issued share exceeds authorized capital, the board shall pass an allotment-validation resolution and file a memorandum amendment to increase authorized capital; statutory late fees are avoided by immediate curative filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Belize Financial Intelligence Unit and corresponding commercial bank or international banking institution
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, register of directors, corporate resolutions and beneficial ownership particulars to the chosen bank; complete client due diligence and source-of-funds declarations before activating the escrow and SWIFT payment rails.
required_dossiers: Copy of board resolution and signatory mandate
Proof of source of funds and counterparty documentation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the application for inadequate economic substance, supplement the file with physical office evidence, local registered agent confirmation and a detailed factoring transaction flowchart; if rejection persists, pivot to a secondary banking institution with an enhanced compliance opinion from local counsel.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Belize International Financial Services Commission (IFSC) in coordination with the Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Factoring Services License for Trade Supply Chain Factoring under the International Financial Services Commission Act

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment, Ministry of Sustainable Development, Climate Change and Disaster Risk Management, Belize
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration Only – No Mandatory Full EIA for office-based factoring operations; screening self-assessment form retained on file
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial process wastewater generation; sanitary discharges to municipal sewer must comply with Belize SI 71 of 1997 effluent limits; HVAC refrigerant and fire-suppression emissions must satisfy the Air Quality Regulations under the Environmental Protection Act; electronic records must follow data-retention standards without hazardous waste creation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from Belize National Fire Service; structural load clearance from the Central Building Authority; and an occupancy and workplace health clearance issued under the Labour Act, maintained at the registered place of business.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Belize Tax Service Department, Ministry of Finance; online portal: https://taxservices.gov.bz (TIN and GST electronic filing and registration). The annual license fee and Economic Substance compliance for IBCs are administered separately by the International Financial Services Commission of Belize (IFSC), https://www.ifsc.gov.bz.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Belize IBC engaged purely in offshore factoring is exempt from income and business tax and is not required to obtain a Belize TIN. If the IBC establishes a local taxable nexus (2021 IBC amendment permits resident-facing activities), employs Belize staff (PAYE), or makes GST-registrable supplies, the entity must file the TIN/GST application (Form GST-01) with the Belize Tax Service. Required documents: certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles of association, registered office certificate, passport copies of directors and shareholders, registered agent confirmation, and an IFSC clean-standing certificate. TIN issuance takes 5-10 business days. For offshore-only factoring, the tax identity is evidenced by the IFSC IBC certificate and annual license receipt, not by a domestic TIN.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Belize does not operate a US-style check-the-box regime. Statutory mechanisms available: (i) election to redomicile or continue a foreign corporation as a Belize IBC under the IBC Act; (ii) election under the 2021 amendment to conduct business with Belize residents, which partially removes the tax-exempt status; (iii) election by a partly-exempt GST registrant to use a special input tax apportionment method; (iv) opt-in filing of Economic Substance returns with the IFSC to comply with OECD/EU nexus requirements. Belize has not domesticated OECD hybrid-mismatch rules; cross-border factoring structures are documented affirmatively to avoid hybrid deduction mismatches.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: General Sales Tax (GST) — VAT-styled consumption tax under the General Sales Tax Act (Cap. 71), effective 1 July 2006
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: BZD 75,000 annual taxable supplies (approximately USD 37,500); non-resident suppliers of taxable services into Belize are also registrable once the same threshold is met
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance mandate, no continuous transaction control (CTC) e-invoicing system, and no digital stamping regime is in force. Belize permits paper and PDF invoicing, with GST e-filing through the Belize Tax Service portal; monthly GST returns are due by the 15th day of the following month. Factoring fee invoices issued by an offshore IBC to non-resident clients are outside the scope of Belize GST, and no API clearance or e-invoicing obligation attaches to such supplies.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to goods physically exported from Belize and to exported services supplied to a non-resident recipient. For an IBC engaged in accounts receivable factoring and cross-border reverse factoring, zero-rating eligibility requires: (i) the factoring service is supplied to a person resident outside Belize; (ii) the benefit of the service is received outside Belize; (iii) the service is supplied for the direct realization of foreign currency; and (iv) full documentary evidence is retained. Local financial services are exempt rather than zero-rated, meaning input GST is blocked for domestic supplies; however, export supplies to non-residents are zero-rated or outside scope, permitting input VAT recovery through periodic GST refund claims.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Airway Bill (for goods) / signed factoring service contract with benefit-receipt evidence (for services)
Commercial Invoice and Detailedi Factoring Fee Statement
Foreign Currency Payment Evidence / Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent export zero-rating claims or overstatement of export proceeds trigger retrospective assessments, clawback of refunds and input credits, and interest charges. Under section 66 of the General Sales Tax Act, conviction on indictment attracts fines up to BZD 25,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years; false declarations attract an additional civil penalty of up to 200% of the tax evaded. Adverse findings on Economic Substance or anti-money laundering grounds may also result in IFSC license revocation, director disqualification, and a six-year statutory limitation period for reassessment.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Belize (CBB), exercising foreign exchange administration under the Exchange Control Act, Chapter 307 of the Laws of Belize, and the Exchange Control (General) Regulations; the CBB is the sole licensing authority for authorised dealers and is the primary supervisor of commercial banks for cross-border settlement and balance-of-payments reporting.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Belize dollar is pegged at a fixed rate of BZD 2.00 to USD 1.00. Current-account convertibility for trade in goods and services, including factoring and related trade-finance disbursements, is generally unrestricted. Capital-account transactions by resident entities require Central Bank approval, but an International Business Company is classified as a non-resident legal person for exchange-control purposes. An IBC is statutorily permitted to deal in, and hold, any foreign currency other than the Belize dollar, and is exempt from CBB controls on external accounts. Profit remittance to non-resident shareholders is therefore not subject to a special CBB profit-remittance permit; the real-world hurdles are purely bank-level, namely proof of economic substance, source of funds, and an updated tax-exemption certificate from the relevant Belize authority.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Exchange Control (General) Regulations, a domestic exporter must offer all export proceeds to an authorised dealer in foreign currency within ninety (90) days from the date of exportation. The mandatory conversion ratio is 100% where the exporter intends to credit a Belize-dollar account or to use the funds domestically. For a Belize IBC operating as a non-resident factoring company, export proceeds may be routed directly to an external USD escrow or trust account without surrender to the Central Bank, provided that no underlying transaction involves a Belize resident, no invoice is denominated in Belize dollars, and no funds are repatriated into the domestic banking system. If proceeds are physically brought into Belize and credited to a local commercial bank, the 90-day and 100% surrender rules will apply at the receiving authorised dealer.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Domestic State-Bank Account (Not Recommended for IBC Offshore Factoring)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-Medium. Offshore digital EMIs such as Airwallex, Currencycloud, and Wise Platform are not licensed banks in Belize and cannot provide a Belize-dollar account. A Belize IBC may open a multi-currency account at a select EMI only if the EMI accepts high-risk non-resident corporations and the IBC satisfies enhanced due diligence. Most prominent EMIs either exclude Belize-incorporated entities outright or require three years of corporate financials, audited statements, business substance evidence, and sanctions/UBO screening. Legal constraints are that the EMI has no CBB regulatory status, no BZD activity is permissible, and all USD transactions clear through United States partner banks subject to OFAC and comprehensive sanctions filters. An EMI may therefore serve only as a supplementary collections rail for factoring receipts; a licensed Belize commercial bank remains necessary for escrow, documentary LC issuance, and statutory treasury functions.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Belize AML/CFT legislation does not impose a statutory requirement for directors to appear physically at a bank branch. Remote onboarding is permitted through a notarised/certified corporate package, apostilled register documents, and a live video interview. In practice, all tier-1 Belize commercial banks mandate at least a recorded virtual meeting with the ultimate beneficial owner or a fully authorised officer. For factoring and trade-finance IBCs, most banks will require the registered agent in Belize to confirm UBO identities, provide a letter of introduction, and transmit the corporate records under the licensed-agent seal. A minority of banks, when the entity exceeds the medium-risk threshold or when the beneficial owner is resident in a higher-risk jurisdiction, will insist on one physical interview at the bank's Belize City or Belmopan branch.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: Nominee shareholders, bearer-share structure, or inability to identify a natural person as the ultimate beneficial owner.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A registered-agent certificate from a licensed Belize registered agent; full UBO disclosure in the form of a declaration of trust; passport copies and proof of address for every individual at or above 10% ownership; professional reference from bank or counsel; negative news and sanctions screen results for all UBOs; signed confirmation from the registered agent that the beneficial-owner register is physically maintained at the registered office.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: Factoring portfolio contains unverified invoices, unknown third-party payors, or debtors in sanctioned or opaque jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A complete accounts-receivable ledger with aged balances and debtor names and addresses; executed invoice assignments and notices of assignment to each debtor; copy of the factoring agreement and reverse-factoring contracts; underlying commercial sales or service agreements; shipping customs documentation or digital service delivery evidence; OFAC/EU/UN sanctions screening reports on each debtor; PEP status declarations; and, where possible, trade-credit insurance or a bank reference on the largest debtors.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: Disbursements represent rapid purchase of receivables followed by third-party payments without clear trade flow, suggesting trade-based money laundering or invoice manipulation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board minutes approving each disbursement; source-of-funds evidence from the factoring financier; full commercial invoice set with matching values, dates, and product/duty codes; logistics documents such as bills of lading, airway bills, CMR notes or freight-forwarder certificates; payment reconciliation between the invoice, the debtors final settlement, and the disbursement; transaction-level sanctions screening; and a written policy prohibiting invoice discounting in the absence of sea or electronic shipment evidence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: No physical substance, business premises, local staff, or audited financials in Belize or in the domicile of the factoring operation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Lease or management-services agreement maintained with a licensed Belize management company; registered office and registered agent certificate; CVs and declarations of the directors/officers, including any local agent; minutes of the first and subsequent board meetings; an economic-substance memorandum confirming the IBCs non-resident and non-taxable status; evidence of a professional accountant, tax advisor, or compliance officer retained by the entity; and the latest annual return filing receipt or certificate of good standing.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity and shareholder-loan funds must be routed through formal banking channels only. Use SWIFT MT103 messages for all wire transfers, with full originator and beneficiary identification, and clear the final USD credit through a United States correspondent bank galvanized by Fedwire. The IBCs Belize commercial bank should be notified in advance with a capital subscription letter, board resolution, register of members excerpt, and proof of source of funds from the investor(s). Purpose codes in the payment message should state either Equity subscription under section 24 of the International Business Companies Act or Capital contribution in support of international trade factoring, whichever the receiving bank accepts for balance-of-payments reporting. The receiving bank will verify that the originator name matches the shareholder ledger and that the wire does not derive from a sanctioned jurisdiction. No cash, bearer-negotiable instruments, opaque intermediary funds, or Hong Kong/Offshore shell transfers are acceptable. Upon receipt, the funds must be recorded in the IBCs share-capital or shareholder-loan account, and a register update or share certificate issue should be completed if the company operates with authorised share capital.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound clearing for factoring operations uses two primary rails. First, SWIFT MT103 for direct payment of factoring proceeds, supplier settlements, and debt-repayment wires, utilising USD, EUR, or GBP settlement through the IBCs commercial bank. Second, the issuances of a SWIFT MT700 commercial letter of credit where the factoring facility requires a bank-side guarantee of trade drafts. Interbank reimbursement may be executed via SWIFT MT202 or MT400 depending on the correspondent arrangement. All outbound messages must carry detailed trade-purpose annotations, such as Invoice discounting disbursement, Factoring advance against assigned receivables, or Reverse-factoring supplier payment, together with invoice references. The Belize bank will apply strict two-signatory authorisation, positive-pay reconciliation, and automated screening against OFAC and the UK/EU sanctions list. Transactions involving Belize dollars are discouraged and, if required, must occur at the fixed rate of BZD 2.00 = USD 1.00 with complete CBB reporting. The IBC must retain full MT103/MT700 records, the underlying invoices, shipping or service evidence, and debtor settlement statements for a minimum of five years to substantiate the genuine trade character of each payment.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable outright forward contracts in major freely convertible currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, CHF) designated for hedging expected factoring receivables and supplier disbursements.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDF) for emerging-market currencies present in the factoring portfolio, executed offshore through international counterparties, because onshore Belize banks are not active market-makers in such currencies.

Cross-currency swaps, including notional-only par structures, permitted solely to align the currency of the IBCs liabilities with its USD/EUR/GBP receivables and to prevent mismatches in the treasury account.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual IBC License Fee renewal (equivalent of annual return; no separate annual return form is filed for a Belize IBC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (Registrar of International Business Companies), Belmopan, Belize
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 July of each calendar year; newly incorporated IBCs pay the initial fee at incorporation and the first annual renewal falls due on the next 31 July
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty equal to the greater of US$100 or 10% of the unpaid annual fee accrues after 31 July; where arrears remain unpaid for more than 90 days, the Registrar may issue a strike-off notice and administratively dissolve the IBC; restoration after strike-off requires payment of all arrears, penalties, and a restoration fee

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Economic Substance Notification and Return (relevant activity: financing and leasing business — trade factoring / reverse factoring)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Economic Substance Unit, International Financial Services Commission (IFSC), Belize
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 12 months after the end of the financial year (calendar-year accounting period recommended for Belize IBCs); the notification obligation applies from the first financial period commencing after adoption of the Economic Substance Act
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or to meet the economic substance test attracts administrative financial penalties of up to BZ$50,000 (approximately US$25,000) plus daily default penalties; the ESU may exchange information with foreign tax authorities and may refer persistent defaulters to the Registrar for strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership (UBO) and Statutory Registers Confirmation submitted by the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (through a Belize-licensed registered agent); UBO file retained at the registered office in Belize
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation filed concurrently with the 31 July license fee renewal; registers and UBO records must be amended within 30 days of any share transfer, allotment, or directorship change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unlawful default in keeping or updating the statutory registers and UBO file is an offence under the Companies (International Business Companies) Act and the Money Laundering and Terrorism (Prevention) Act; fines up to BZ$25,000 (approximately US$12,500) may be imposed on the company or its officers, and the Registrar may decline to issue a certificate of good standing

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statutory register audit certification by the registered agent (review of Register of Members, Register of Directors, Register of Charges, minute books and UBO file)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Prepared for the board of directors and retained by the registered agent; produced to the Registrar, FIU or tax authorities on demand
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Completed as an internal compliance step not later than the 31 July renewal date; updated within 30 days after any register event (e.g. transfer, allotment, appointment or resignation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inaccurate or missing register audit records may expose the registered agent to license-related sanctions under the International Financial Services Commission supervision regime and the company to adverse inferences regarding good standing

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No revenue-, asset- or employee-size threshold applies to a Belize IBC; an independent statutory audit is compulsory only where the IBC owns an interest in land in Belize or carries on business within Belize, where it holds an IFSC licence (banking, trust, insurance, money services or mutual fund), or where the board of directors or shareholders resolve to obtain an audit. A trade-factoring IBC engaged exclusively outside Belize is exempt from filing audited accounts, but a licensed financial/factoring operation is normally required by its IFSC licence to submit audited IFRS financial statements within 6 months of its financial year-end.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB is the accepted framework for licensed and public-interest entities; unlicensed IBCs may maintain accounts under IFRS or US GAAP on a consistent double-entry basis; Belize IBCs are tax-exempt and are not required to file statutory tax accounts with a domestic revenue authority.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The licensed Belize registered agent must obtain, verify and hold current UBO identification at the registered office. Every share transfer, allotment or change of beneficial ownership (including changes resulting from cross-border factoring-securitisation arrangements) must be recorded within 30 days. At the 31 July annual renewal, the registered agent files a confirmation certifying that the UBO file and registers are accurate; where no ownership or directorship movement occurred during the year, a nil-confirmation is filed. The UBO register is non-public and may be inspected only by the Registrar, the Financial Intelligence Unit, and competent tax authorities under exchange-of-information powers.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (share ledger, share transfers and allotments)
Register of Charges (mortgages, debentures and security interests)
Beneficial Ownership Register (UBO file maintained by the registered agent)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$500 - US$1,200 per annum for a Belize-licensed registered agent inclusive of registered office and standard compliance support; larger financial groups or entities requiring economic-substance documentation may pay US$1,500 - US$2,500
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$3,000 - US$10,000 for audited IFRS financial statements of a small to mid-size trade-factoring entity; nil where the IBC is fully exempt from statutory audit and prepares unaudited internal management accounts only

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% on foreign-source income for a qualifying International Business Company (IBC) under the tax exemption granted by the International Business Companies Act (Cap. 270); standard Income and Business Tax rate of 25% on chargeable income for non-exempt companies, with Business Tax on gross receipts at 6% for financial and other service activities effectively operating as a minimum tax.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: IBC statutory exemption from income tax, business tax, withholding tax and capital gains tax for offshore income; grandfathered 50-year tax exemption available to pre-2019 IBCs; no stamp duty on issue or transfer of IBC shares; no branch profit remittance tax (0% dividend withholding on distributions to non-resident shareholders).
